title: v2.1.257
content: What's changed Added Claude Fable 5.1 ( claude-fable-5-1 ), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $10/$50 per Mtok with $0.25/Mtok cache reads Added "Time format" ( timeFormat ) and timeZone settings: 12-hour, 24-hour, 24-hour UTC, or a strftime pattern for the turn-end clock and transcript-view timestamps Added a Containment Escape rule to auto mode so cloud metadata-credential fetches, egress evasion, and cross-tenant reach are no longer auto-approved unless your environment marks them expected Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE to apply CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL (or the main model) to every subagent, ignoring per-spawn and agent-definition model overrides Added s in /effort to change effort for the current session only, matching /model Added a /doctor warning for stale sandbox mask files left by a killed session Added a one-time prompt in auto mode before the first file read outside the working directories, with the option to block such reads ( permissions.blockReadsOutside
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.257 版本发布，引入 Claude Fable 5.1 作为默认 Fable 模型（1M 上下文，$10/$50 每百万 token，缓存读取 $0.25）。新增时间格式与时区设置、auto 模式下的 Containment Escape 安全规则（阻止云元数据凭证获取与跨租户访问的自动批准）、CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE 环境变量强制统一子代理模型，以及 /effort 会话级 effort 切换和 /doctor 沙箱过期警告。

title: Update claude-api skill: Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1, Managed Agent…
content:
Update claude-api skill: Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1, Managed Agents updates, cost-optimize (#1704)

* Update claude-api skill: Managed Agents self-hosted memory stores and web tool domain settings, cost-optimize subcommand, Admin API reference, ASCII-only text

Managed Agents: self-hosted sandboxes can now attach memory stores via the SDK worker (handle_item, ANTHROPIC_WORK_SECRET, sync options, troubleshooting); web_search/web_fetch accept allowed_domains/blocked_domains/user_location/max_content_tokens on the toolset configs entry and are not governed by environment networking; typed per-tool config unions; Console session viewer notes; packages caveat under limited networking; Claude Platform on AWS self-hosted worker auth.

New shared/cost-optimization.md backing a cost-optimize subcommand, and new shared/admin-api.md covering client.beta.organization in all SDKs and the CLI. Prompt caching gains TTL selection, automatic vs explicit breakpoint guidance, workspace isolation, and
author: rlancemartin
summary_zh: Anthropic 官方 skills 仓库更新 claude-api skill，同步 Claude Fable 5.1 / Mythos 5.1 模型信息，并扩充 Managed Agents 文档：自托管沙箱可挂载记忆存储、web_search/web_fetch 支持域名白名单与地理位置配置。新增 cost-optimize 子命令及 shared/cost-optimization.md 成本优化指南，并补充 Admin API 参考，对使用 Claude API 构建 Agent 的开发者有直接参考价值。

title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and says it’s up to 45 percent cheaper for agentic work
content: Anthropic says its newest AI models, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, address criticisms from customers about price, data retention, and overzealous safeguards. The company claims Claude Fable 5.1 offers stronger performance than Fable 5, but costs around 25 percent less typically and up to 45 percent less for complex agentic tasks, thanks to reduced pricing […]
author: Stevie Bonifield
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.1 与 Mythos 5.1 两款新模型，宣称性能优于 Fable 5，同时常规定价降低约 25%，复杂智能体（agentic）任务成本最高可降低 45%。新模型还回应了客户对数据保留策略和过度安全限制的批评，对使用 Claude Code 及构建 agent 工作流的开发者而言意味着更低成本与更少误拦截。
pin_reason: Claude 主力模型的重大版本发布，直接影响 Claude Code 与 agentic 工作流的成本结构和能力边界，具有长期参考价值。

title: Path to Astra: critical capabilities and frontier safeguards
content: Astra is the first OpenAI model to meet the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold under the Preparedness Framework, with stronger safeguards for release.
summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 Astra 模型，这是首个在 Preparedness Framework 下达到「Critical」网络安全能力阈值的模型，并为此配备了更强的发布安全防护措施。文章揭示了前沿模型能力跃升与安全治理之间的权衡，对关注 AI 编程/安全能力边界的开发者具有参考意义，但与 Claude Code 具体使用实践关联较弱。

title: How AI-native companies turn workflows into operating capability
content: Basis, Clay, and Exa Labs use AI agents to improve onboarding, account management, and developer integrations. See what enterprise leaders can apply.
summary_zh: OpenAI 官方博客介绍 Basis、Clay 和 Exa Labs 三家 AI 原生公司如何利用 AI 智能体改进用户入职、客户管理和开发者集成流程，将工作流转化为企业运营能力。文章面向企业决策者，提供了可借鉴的 agent 落地案例，但内容偏营销性质、技术细节有限。

title: Anthropic’s new Fable release is cheaper, less restrictive
content: Fable 5.1 includes changes meant to reduce token cost and false-positive restrictions from the model's safeguards.
author: Russell Brandom
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Fable 5.1 模型，重点降低 token 使用成本，并减少安全护栏导致的误报拒答问题。对于使用 Claude Code 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，意味着更低的调用成本和更少的无谓拦截，提升日常工作流的流畅度。原文信息量较少，仅为简讯级别。
